_comment: The department routing partition for Titan Flooring. Consumed by .claude/commands/route.md to decide which department owns an incoming request, and by department lead agents to know which files they may read. A new department, or a source changing hands, is a one-line data edit here — never a prose edit in route.md. Verified against .claude/agents/ and .claude/commands/ on 2026-09-10.
_maintenance: owns.sources[] across all departments MUST be a partition of the ingest sources in CLAUDE.md's agent table: every source owned exactly once. A source owned twice routes non-deterministically; a source owned by nobody falls silently to `general`. tests/test_departments_registry.py enforces both, plus the rule that no *-actions agent may appear in a specialists.readonly[] list. When an agent or command is added or renamed, update the entry here in the same change — a dangling name in specialists[] or owns.commands[] is a routing bug, not a typo.
_no_sensitivity_note: There is deliberately no `sensitivity` or `write_policy` key anywhere in this file. A department is NOT a sensitivity boundary — provenance decides (Albert, 2026-08-02). Item sensitivity is set at ingest per contracts/ingest-schema.md and defaulted per source in notion-destinations.json `source_defaults`; write_policy lives on the destination being written to. Mirroring either here would create a second source of truth that silently disagrees with the first.

sales._note: plan_file is plans/{date}/plan.json, NOT dept-plan-sales.json. /manager-dashboard reads that exact path and contracts/plan-schema.md states it literally. Sales is grandfathered on the plan-1 envelope; its actions[] entries are already the shape contracts/dept-plan-schema.md cites, so nothing diverges where it matters.

operations.spec_reason: The source is live and findings recur daily (stale tactical tasks, QA error statuses, won projects missing an Opportunity ID), but no rule table exists yet. Until ops-lead-agent is written, requests routed here are answered inline from ingest/<date>/notion.json — never planned.
operations._note: /notion-sync is NOT listed under owns.commands. It writes GHL-derived candidates to the Tactical Tasks List, so it belongs to Sales even though its destination is a Notion database Operations reads. This is why ownership keys on source, not platform.

catalogue._note: kind is `command`, not `agent` — this department's lead is /catalog-sync plus scripts/catalog_reconcile.py, and it predates the lead-agent pattern. It is registered so routing is complete, not so it can be rebuilt. It contributes no ingest source: the catalogue pipeline is not part of /daily-ingest.

marketing.spec_reason: Tier 1 work is missing, not Tier 3. There is no methods/marketing-framework.md defining CPL or its baseline, and no platform-settings/meta-ads.json holding thresholds — meta-ads is the only ingest source with no registry file. A lead built now would hardcode the '~$14 7-day CPL baseline' the daily brief quotes from nowhere.
promote_criteria: methods/marketing-framework.md exists and defines CPL, the baseline window, and what counts as a delivery problem
platform-settings/meta-ads.json exists and holds the thresholds that framework names
a second distinct marketing question has been asked (rule of two, CLAUDE.md analysis ladder)

finance.blocked_reason: bookkeeper-ingest-agent has written status: "error" on every recorded run from 2026-07-26 through 2026-09-08 — sixteen consecutive failures — because no Intuit QuickBooks MCP server is configured in .mcp.json and there is no scripts/bookkeeper_pull.py equivalent to scripts/outlook_pull.py. The AGENT has no access path. CORRECTED 2026-09-11: this entry previously said the source "has never worked", which is false. The QBO read path DID work — Make scenario 4822446 pulled 102 real chart-of-accounts records and 4822687 pulled two full P&L reports on 2026-07-11 and 2026-07-12, and those artifacts are still in Make data stores 88653 and 88661 against a connection valid to 2026-11-01. The real blocker is narrower: the working read path lives in Make, every bookkeeper scenario there is on-demand with no trigger so nothing has re-run in two months, and nothing bridges Make to ingest/<date>/bookkeeper.json. See platform-settings/quickbooks.json for the connection facts and the defects in those scenarios.
unblock_criteria: a working QBO read path reaches the agent — either scripts/bookkeeper_pull.py against a direct Intuit client, or the Make scenarios given typed interfaces and a trigger (platform-settings/quickbooks.json records both options)
ingest/run-ledger.json shows three consecutive entries with bookkeeper: "ok"
then, and only then, write the Finance lead with a rule table derived from those three real days
finance._note: partial_answer_sources is what route.md may fall back to for a finance-shaped question, ALWAYS labelled as partial. A Notion payments-log figure is not bookkeeping and must never be presented as if it were. GHL value_cents is deliberately not listed — it is pipeline value, not money received. airtable:company_gross_data/project_log is added 2026-09-11 as a second partial source: it is the only MACHINE-READABLE copy of the Notion Project Financials figures, because every money property on Project Financials is a formula or rollup that the Notion MCP returns as an opaque reference rather than a number. It is a mirror of unknown freshness, so it is a partial answer, never the book. ls-sales is owned here, NOT by Catalogue, because ownership keys on SOURCE and this source is the sales ledger rather than the product catalogue. The bare platform string `lightspeed` deliberately stays with Catalogue so routing precedence step 3 still resolves to exactly one department; Finance takes `pos`, `register` and `closeout` instead. A request naming `lightspeed` alone is a catalogue request.
known_defects_blocking_automation: Make 4824368 Register Closure Watchdog filters MetaData.CreateTime > '2027-01-01', a future date, so its alarm ALWAYS fires. Do not schedule it until the literal is dynamic.
Make 4822687 Pull P&L has a hardcoded 2026-01-01..2026-07-13 range and cannot produce a current P&L.
Make 4841468 Outlook->QBO Receipts has no dedupe store and moves messages only as its last step, so a mid-run failure duplicates receipts in QBO.

general._note: General is the fallback lane AND the owner of outlook. outlook routes here rather than to a department because the 2026-08-03 per-staff-destination direction is unbuilt: staff mail has no correct destination yet, and assigning it to a department before one exists is the misfiling contracts/notion-task-schema.md forbids. General has no lead agent — /route answers inline from files already in ingest/, or asks one clarifying question.

routing._comment: Fixed precedence, first match wins. No scoring, no confidence thresholds — the same discipline notion-sync.md uses for sensitivity: routing is a lookup, never inferred from content.
precedence: explicit — the request names a department key or matches a route_keywords[] entry
command_named — the request names a command in some department's owns.commands[]
source_named — the request names a source, sub_source, or platform owned by exactly one department
routing.ambiguity_rule: If a precedence step matches more than one department, record every match in the request log's routing.alternatives[] and ASK. Ambiguity is surfaced, never resolved silently.
routing.keyword_matching: Whole-word, case-insensitive. A route_keywords[] entry matches only on word boundaries — never as a substring. This is not a detail: matching 'ad' as a substring pulls every mention of 'leads' into Marketing. A multi-word entry ('price list', 'stale lead') matches as a whole phrase, also on word boundaries.
routing.specificity_rule: When the matched keywords include one that contains another as a whole phrase, the LONGER match wins and the shorter is discarded before the ambiguity check. 'cost per lead' beats 'lead'; 'stale lead' beats 'lead'. This resolves the common case where a specific phrase belongs to one department and a word inside it belongs to another, without which every CPL question would be a pointless ask. It is a tie-break on matches already found, never a way to match something that did not.
